meta.name: spec-release-node
meta.author: JOSFOX LLC
meta.description: The .jos node of a specification release: it holds the flows, documents, runs, ledger, authorization, templates and business notes of the effort, and the context it reads. Children of this folder may only restrict what it allows.

intention.objective: Produce a specification release (normative text, JSON Schema, vectors, examples and registration template) that a reviewer can verify offline, with every decision recorded and every claim measured
success_criteria: SC1 ticket: the owner answers the registration ticket before the deadline
SC2 name: one subtype in every document (specification, schema, examples, template)
SC3 compatibility: every valid 1.0.0 document validates against the 2.0 schema
SC4 superset: the 2.0 schema covers every root member of 1.0.0
SC5 pipeline: flows/review-flow.jos runs with independent reviewers and scorers
SC6 evidence: every finding has a rubric check identifier and a verified citation
SC7 repository: the specification repository passes the quality gate
SC8 vectors: tests/ holds valid and invalid vectors for every MUST
SC9 example: the specification includes this pipeline as an example
SC10 directory: the specification defines kind directory and its inheritance
SC11 published: the specification repository has the tag of the version
SC12 runtime: the command-line runtime reads 0.0.7, 1.0.0 and 2.0
SC13 examples: examples/ run without network access
SC14 template: one name, one encoding, one fragment syntax in the template
SC15 tag: the published specification and every $id cite a tag
SC16 name: the subtype is not already in the registry
SC17 security: declarative active content, injection, resource limits and privacy are covered
SC18 fragments and extension: JSON Pointer with an example
SC19 calibration: tests/seeded/ holds at least 5 packages with one known defect each
SC20 offline sources: sources/ holds the cited RFCs and the registry snapshot

avoid: writing to, pushing to or commenting on the public repository
sending mail on behalf of the owner without approval
changing the subtype of an open ticket without a written decision
using a single model vendor for reviewers and responder
accepting a confidence verdict without a reproducible run
secrets or keys in any file of this folder
a scorer from the vendor of the responder
confidence reported by a model about itself: only the rubric counts
require: every run of the pipeline leaves runs/<run-id>/ with inputs, outputs and hashes
every change to the normative text passes schema validation before commit
the documents in sources/ are read only; corrections go to a new file
human approval at every gate marked human
local commits with the prefix feat(spec) or docs(spec)
the dated plan lives in docs/PLAN.md and is updated after every session

review-flow.description: Review flow with independent reviewers, a responder and scorers

validate-schema.description: Validate this node and its flows against 1.0.0

release.description: Full path from the sources to the submission
